newsitem.title: SPAIN: Grenades explode in northern Spain; ETA suspected.
newsitem.headline: Grenades explode in northern Spain; ETA suspected.

text.p: Two grenades exploded near a police station in northern Spain on Monday, injuring one person, in an apparent attack by Basque separatist guerrillas, state radio reported.
The attack, using grenade launchers, occurred just over a week after ETA rebels sparked national outrage by killing a young Spanish politician.
The target on Monday was the National Police station in Oviedo, capital of the Asturias region.
But the grenades missed the station, with one exploding on the patio of a nearby building and the other hitting a street, state radio said.
A woman was slightly injured and was being treated at a local hospital.
Police cordoned off the area and found a third unexploded grenade that had to be deactivated. They found two grenade launchers used in the attack. No arrests were made.
